newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu says Palestinians plan wave of violence.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu says Palestinians plan wave of violence.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Sunday that "senior elements" among the Palestinians had long been laying the ground for a wave of violence without connection to his government's decision to give more benefits to Jewish settlements.

"There is clear information that the Palestinian side, senior elements on the Palestinian side, have been planning, without connection to the government decision, for weeks, planning another wave of violence," Netanyahyu told Israel Radio.

Netanyahu, asked about reports Israeli Shin Bet secret service head Ami Ayalon had warned him that expansion of settlement on occupied Arab lands at this stage would cause an explosion in the areas, dismissed the reported warnings.
"Again, an inaccurate quote from inside a meeting and I do not want to enter into details now. Every security source can estimate freely, give his opinion, and that's what is done," he said.
"It is also their obligation, in my opinion, and they also understand this, that during the taking of decisions themselves that has to remain with the political echelon."

The Israeli government on Friday decided to reinstate financial benefits to settlements in the West Bank after a guerrilla attack last week in which a settler and her son were killed. Israel's former government, that concluded interim peace deals with the Palestinians, had cancelled the benefits.
